leakage_checks.description: six tasks partition 3 train / 1 val / 2 blind test by task identity
meta_train/meta_val/meta_test task ID sets are disjoint
meta_test is blind: no M1/M2 run, no labels read, no early stopping
normalization and label transforms fit on meta_train only
no query label, held-out optimum or future evaluation is read
no height-copy pseudo tasks remain; all tasks are fixed 18,288 m
M2.02 has F1R2/F2R2 continuity exposure, but it is meta_train/metadata only
M2.2 and M1.8 have no prior real task exposure and no inherited expected polar
shared designs across tasks are intentional transfer, not task-identity leakage
M3 test labels are only permitted after M1-A/M1-B admission and separate authorization
